name: Steps
description: A numbered flow indicator with done, current, and upcoming states.

anatomy.description: Numbered circles that switch to a check once a step is done.
Step names; the current step sets aria-current="step".
Lines between markers that fill as steps complete.

dos: Provide onStepClick so people can return to completed steps.
Keep step labels to short nouns.
donts: Don't let people jump ahead; only completed steps become clickable.
Don't use it as page navigation; it tracks one flow's progress.

examples.title: Flow progress
examples.description: Completed steps can be clickable; the current step sets aria-current.

examples.title: Clickable completed steps
examples.description: Allow returning to completed steps with onStepClick.

guidance.useWhen: A flow has a clear sequence and the user benefits from seeing progress.
guidance.avoidWhen: Steps are independent views; use Tabs or navigation.
guidance.behavior: The current step sets aria-current and completed steps can be made clickable.
guidance.responsive: Steps wrap with their labels on narrow screens; keep labels short.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between the clickable completed steps.
Jumps back to the focused completed step.

notes: Rendered as an ordered list, so each step's position and the total count are announced.
Only completed steps become buttons when onStepClick is provided; upcoming steps stay inert.

props.description: Zero-based index of the current step. Earlier steps render as completed.
props.name: current

props.description: When provided, completed steps render as buttons and call this with their index.
props.name: onStepClick
